instructions: Begin from a stable climbing stance with three points of contact when possible.

Move at a controlled pace for the planned duration or route.

exercises.name: Deadlift High Pull

source_english.description: Deadlift High Pull hinges to the barbell, drives the floor away, and finishes with the hips tall before reversing the hinge.
instructions: Stand over the barbell and hinge to grip it with a neutral spine.
Drive through the floor and extend the hips and knees to stand tall.
After hip extension, pull the bar toward the upper chest with elbows high.
Lower the bar under control and reset.
form_cues: Keep the shoulders over the bar or weights.
Finish with glutes, not lumbar extension.
source_english.safety_note: Use a load that allows a neutral spine from setup through lockout.

source_english.description: Dumbbell Snatch accelerates dumbbells from the floor or hang into a stable overhead position in one continuous lift.

Drive through the legs and hips, keeping the load close as it rises.
Pull under or guide the weight to a stable overhead position with the arm locked out.
Lower safely and reset for the next repetition.
